scripts.test-read: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/networkConfig.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/config-read-only.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test
scripts.test-comprehensive: npx caliper launch manager --caliper-workspace . --caliper-networkconfig networks/networkConfig.yaml --caliper-benchconfig benchmarks/config-comprehensive.yaml --caliper-flow-only-test
